themes.summary: Many buyers say FeatureShift is simple, easy to set up, and does exactly what it promises.

hits.quote: Its simple and it does what it says... Brilliant! I've found that it can
We had our public roadmap portal live and embedded in our app in under an hour.
It’s easy-peasy, fast, and makes you look like a genius boss.
Good combination of upvote tool and changelog, comes with several workspaces
FeatureShift is a service that delivers exactly what it promises.
Does what it says. Super easy to set-up too.
Gathering feature requests, bug reports, and publishing our own changelog has never been easier.
I really like the approach of simplicity combined with all features I wanted
Super simple to setup, even clear instructions with CNAME.
First of all the app is very intuitive, easy to configure and does what it promises to do!
The UI is clean and neat which is exactly what I was looking for.
UI is clean and the product works really well.
Everything just works out of the box. Super easy and simple to use.

themes.summary: Several 5-star reviewers still ask for more development, integrations, and admin controls.

hits.quote: However, there hasn't been any new functionality or development in sight for a while now.
It would be nice if the notification email contained more that just the title and generic message.
It'd be awesome if we could manage changelogs from other systems right within the platform,
What would be nice to have: is control for the admin to block access for certain members..
The only downside is that there is only one domain/project supported.

themes.summary: Several buyers call FeatureShift a steal and great value for the price.

hits.quote: What a great price for such an understated tool!
Excellent Value for Money: Compared to clunky, enterprise-grade tools that cost a fortune,
The value for money on this purchase is well beyond what I expected.
Highly recommended, and the price is great!

themes.summary: Several buyers say the team responds within minutes to hours and quickly implements requested features.

hits.quote: within days they've implemented major features we've requested
Andreas responded within minutes! Now that's incredible these days.
we requested a feature that was implemented in less than 24 hours.
